what: At the center of a dark veil covering the page, a 300×150 canvas draws a 2:3 Lissajous curve (horizontal radius 40%, vertical 34%) whose phase rotates .5rad per second — a thin line (1.7px) over a bleeding thick line (3.2px · glow 16px · opacity .55). A 220×2px bar below fills with the loaded share, and once fully loaded the veil lifts in .5s after 180ms and is removed after 520ms

options.hold: Delay before leaving once fully loaded (s), default .18
options.max: Latest time it starts walking (sec), default 20

use: (canvas and bar are created if missing. If there is more to wait for, root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fx:wait', { detail: promise })), when it clears, fx:done)
note: By default it waits for window load and document.fonts.ready. For screens flipped often like apps, shorten hold·fade to near 0

from.where: shared.js .kt-boot (two pages) — original boot cover: 2:3 Lissajous .4w·.34h, phase .5rad/s, 16 white lights at 3.2px + 1.7px line, bar scaleX(done/total), opacity 500ms 180ms after finishing, removed 520ms later
